attributes.name: [Chargeback Serverless] Rolling 30-day total spend budget exceeded

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM serverless_billing_cost_lookup
| EVAL threshold_budget = 25000.0, threshold_pct = 80.0, alert_on_projected = true
| INLINE STATS latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE @timestamp > latest_ts - 30 days
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| WHERE ts IS NOT NULL
| RENAME project_id AS _b_pid, project_name AS _b_pname, project_type AS _b_ptype, deployment_group AS _b_dgrp, has_native_billing AS _b_has_nat, event.ingested AS _b_ingested, conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _b_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _b_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _b_sym
| LOOKUP JOIN serverless_project_status_lookup ON composite_key
| RENAME conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _ps_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _ps_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _ps_sym
| EVAL @timestamp = ts
| EVAL project_id = COALESCE(_b_pid, project_id)
| EVAL project_name = CASE(_b_pname IS NOT NULL AND _b_pname != "" AND _b_pname != project_id, _b_pname, project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "" AND project_name != project_id, project_name, _b_pname IS NOT NULL AND _b_pname != "", _b_pname, project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "", project_name, project_id)
| EVAL project_type = CASE(_b_ptype IS NOT NULL AND _b_ptype != "" AND _b_ptype != "unknown", _b_ptype, project_type IS NOT NULL AND project_type != "", project_type, _b_ptype)
| EVAL deployment_group = CASE(COALESCE(_b_has_nat, false) AND updated_at IS NOT NULL, CASE(_b_ingested IS NOT NULL AND _b_ingested >= updated_at, COALESCE(_b_dgrp, ""), COALESCE(deployment_group, "")), COALESCE(_b_has_nat, false), COALESCE(_b_dgrp, ""), _b_dgrp IS NOT NULL AND _b_dgrp != "", _b_dgrp, deployment_group IS NOT NULL AND deployment_group != "", deployment_group, "")
| DROP _b_dgrp, _b_has_nat, _b_ingested
| EVAL _row_rate = COALESCE(_b_rate, _ps_rate, 1.0), _row_unit = COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_b_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_b_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_ps_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_ps_unit)), null), "USD"), _row_sym = COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_b_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_b_sym), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_ps_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_ps_sym), null), "$")
| EVAL _cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN serverless_chargeback_conf_lookup ON _cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| RENAME conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _cfg_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _cfg_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _cfg_sym
| DROP _cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date
| EVAL _cu = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_cfg_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_cfg_unit)), null), _cs = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_cfg_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_cfg_sym), null)
| EVAL conf_chargeable_unit_rate = COALESCE(_cfg_rate, _row_rate, 1.0), unit = COALESCE(_cu, _row_unit, "USD"), currency_symbol = COALESCE(_cs, _row_sym, "$")
| EVAL _lu = CASE(ts == latest_ts, unit, null)
| INLINE STATS _latest_unit = MAX(_lu), _any_unit = MAX(unit)
| EVAL rep_unit = COALESCE(_latest_unit, _any_unit, "USD")
| EVAL _lrr = CASE(ts == latest_ts AND unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, null), _arr = CASE(unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, null), _lrs = CASE(ts == latest_ts AND unit == rep_unit, currency_symbol, null), _ars = CASE(unit == rep_unit, currency_symbol, null)
| INLINE STATS _latest_rep_rate = MAX(_lrr), _any_rep_rate = MAX(_arr), _latest_rep_sym = MAX(_lrs), _any_rep_sym = MAX(_ars)
| EVAL rep_rate = COALESCE(_latest_rep_rate, _any_rep_rate, 1.0), rep_sym = COALESCE(_latest_rep_sym, _any_rep_sym, CASE(rep_unit == "EUR", "€", rep_unit == "GBP", "£", rep_unit == "ZAR", "R", "$"))
| EVAL eff_rate = CASE(unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, rep_rate), unit = rep_unit, currency_symbol = rep_sym
| DROP _lu, _latest_unit, _any_unit, _lrr, _arr, _lrs, _ars, _latest_rep_rate, _any_rep_rate, _latest_rep_sym, _any_rep_sym, rep_unit, rep_rate, rep_sym
| EVAL units = CASE(total_ecu IS NOT NULL, total_ecu, 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * eff_rate
| DROP eff_rate
| EVAL project = CASE(project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "", project_name, project_id IS NOT NULL AND project_id != "", project_id, "organization")
| EVAL project_type_label = CASE(project_type IS NOT NULL AND project_type != "", project_type, "organization")
| EVAL category_label = COALESCE(cost_category, "other")
| EVAL cost_type_label = COALESCE(cost_type, "other")
| EVAL bill_day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, ts)
| EVAL is_synthetic_bucket = (project_id IS NULL OR project_id == "" OR STARTS_WITH(project_id, "deleted_or_unassociated") OR STARTS_WITH(project_id, "unassociated_") OR project_id == "org_level" OR project_id == "organization")
| EVAL active_pid = CASE(cost > 0 AND COALESCE(is_synthetic_bucket, true) == false AND COALESCE(last_status, "") != "inactive", project_id, null)
| STATS
    spend = ROUND(SUM(cost), 2),
    ecu = ROUND(SUM(units), 2),
    billed_days = COUNT_DISTINCT(bill_day),
    active_projects = COUNT_DISTINCT(active_pid),
    latest_day = LEFT(TO_STRING(MAX(ts)), 10),
    threshold = MAX(threshold_budget),
    warn_pct = MAX(threshold_pct),
    check_proj = MAX(alert_on_projected),
    sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "$"),
    unit = COALESCE(MAX(unit), "USD")
| EVAL budget_used_pct = CASE(threshold > 0.0, ROUND(spend * 100.0 / threshold, 1), 0.0)
| EVAL daily_avg_spend = CASE(billed_days > 0, ROUND(spend / TO_DOUBLE(billed_days), 2), 0.0)
| EVAL projected_30d_spend = ROUND(daily_avg_spend * 30.0, 2)
| EVAL projected_pct = CASE(threshold > 0.0, ROUND(projected_30d_spend * 100.0 / threshold, 1), 0.0)
| WHERE budget_used_pct >= warn_pct OR (check_proj == true AND billed_days >= 3 AND projected_30d_spend > threshold)
| EVAL breach_reason = CASE(
    spend > threshold, "budget_exceeded",
    budget_used_pct >= warn_pct, "watermark_reached",
    "projected_30d_overrun"
  )
| EVAL result = CONCAT("[", latest_day, "] Organization 30d spend of ", sym, TO_STRING(spend), " ", unit, " (", TO_STRING(budget_used_pct), "% of ", sym, TO_STRING(threshold), " ", unit, " budget; ", TO_STRING(ecu), " ECU across ", TO_STRING(active_projects), " active projects over ", TO_STRING(billed_days), "d; avg ", sym, TO_STRING(daily_avg_spend), "/day, projected 30d: ", sym, TO_STRING(projected_30d_spend), " ", unit, " / ", TO_STRING(projected_pct), "%) triggered ", breach_reason, " (watermark: ", TO_STRING(warn_pct), "%).")
| KEEP result, latest_day, breach_reason, billed_days, active_projects, spend, budget_used_pct, daily_avg_spend, projected_30d_spend, projected_pct, ecu, threshold, warn_pct, unit
